name: a star stat pops over a faint contribution heatmap
looks: A star icon pops in beside a big rolling number and its caption, while a faint grid of small coloured squares (a contribution heatmap) sits dim in the far background, and two small supporting stat chips key in beneath.
build: data-infographic: the star does a quick scale-snap on back.out as the number starts its digit roll-up; the heatmap grid is a static low-opacity DOM grid behind everything; the chips fade in staggered beneath.
sound: A soft pop on the star, a rising tone under the roll-up, a tick per chip.
prompt: Pop a small icon beside a big rolling stat and its caption, with a faint grid of tiny coloured squares dimmed in the far background suggesting ongoing activity. Key in one or two smaller supporting stat chips beneath a beat later, to back the headline number with context.
